_comment: ICF fold classes for dc3 (build 373307D9). Representation:
transitive-closure classes over witnessed directed pairs.
THREE EVIDENCE CLASSES coexist here; each group carries its own
'evidence' string, and no group is admitted from a name SHAPE:
- body test (decomp-synth tools/revcomp/probes/probe_icf_foldtest.py):
retail bytes at the survivor address are relocation-invariantly
identical to our compiled body for each folded spelling;
- COFF weak external: MSVC declares ??_E<Class> as an undefined weak
external whose aux record names ??_G<Class> (SEARCH_ALIAS);
- orig/373307D9/ham_xbox_r.map, the shipped MSVC linker map: /OPT:ICF
folds byte-identical COMDATs, so symbols sharing an address there
are the fold set, stated by the linker that made the image.
- retail-map DATA COMDAT fold (scripts/install_data_fold_aliases.py,
group names 'retailmap-data:'): the same linker-map address-sharing
evidence, over data COMDATs the function-only symbol read could not
see, AND a byte-identity gate -- our COMDAT contents equal the target
survivor's, relocations masked and reloc targets equal by name.
decomp-synth validate_groups gate (a) cannot run on these: 0 of
target_symbol_map.json's 69,132 names is a data symbol, so
load_validated drops them and grades stricter than this file.
Every tier here except retailmap-data is VALIDATOR-ACCEPTED, so the
synthetic map rendered from it (scripts/gen_icf_alias_map.py ->
build/373307D9/icf_aliases.map) hands objdiff no class the validator
refused ON EVIDENCE. retailmap-data is the one exception and it is a
blind spot rather than a disagreement: validate_groups can only fault
it on gate (a), which no data symbol can satisfy. load_validated drops
it, so decomp-synth grades STRICTER than this file, never looser.
Do not hand-edit. NOTE: build_icf_alias_inputs.py mints the body-test
class ONLY -- regenerating from it alone would drop the other three.
Installers extend this file in place and copy _comment forward.

over_merge_split.what: A closure class holding two TARGET-RESIDENT names is an over-merge: a real ICF fold keeps exactly one spelling. Gate (c) catches it and rejects the WHOLE class, which is why the 76 -> 368 growth LOST five MakeString names the smaller set had -- growing the evidence shrank the accepted set. Such a class is now SPLIT into maximal sub-classes of one target-resident name each.
over_merge_split.why_dropped: Reachable from TWO target-resident survivors, i.e. witnessed folded against both, so no deterministic canonical spelling exists. Same reasoning as gate (e) applies to a name in two groups, same fail-closed direction.

regression_vs_76_class_set.status: REPAIRED for 4 of the 5 names; the 5th was a FALSE admission the growth exposed.
regression_vs_76_class_set.not_recovered_why: Directly witnessed folded against BOTH ??$MakeString@HW4State@SaveLoadManager@@... (3 sites) and ??$MakeString@KH@@YAPBDPBDABKABH@Z (1 site), which are separately target-resident. The 76-class set admitted it only because the smaller closure had not yet seen the second pair; keeping it would canonicalise one name to two distinct addresses.

_provenance.weak_alias_classes: Added 2026-08-10. MSVC emits the vector deleting destructor ??_E<Class> as an UNDEFINED WEAK EXTERNAL whose auxiliary record names its default resolution ??_G<Class> with characteristics 2 (IMAGE_WEAK_EXTERN_SEARCH_ALIAS). The linker resolves one to the other, so these are declared aliases, not empirical folds -- the compiler states it in our own object file. Direction is read off the target: whichever spelling the target objects define is the survivor (893 ??_G, 78 ??_E), because gate (c) requires exactly that.
_provenance.reconciled_with_main: 2026-08-10. Two lanes repaired the same over-merged MakeString class independently -- this lane 368->371 under gate (c'), main 368->373 by splitting. Main's finer partition is authoritative here: this lane's version folded symbols at retail 0x827F84A8 and 0x823B2008 into groups whose survivors sit at 0x82895520 / 0x82610090, which is a false equivalence across four distinct addresses. Main's plain groups were taken wholesale and only this lane's additions re-applied.
_provenance.retail_map_classes: Added 2026-08-10. orig/373307D9/ham_xbox_r.map is the shipped MSVC linker map for this build -- verified same-build by 67,483 of 67,510 names shared with target_symbol_map.json sitting at identical addresses. /OPT:ICF folds byte-identical COMDATs, so symbols sharing an address in that map ARE the fold set, stated by the linker rather than inferred by body test. Admitted narrowly: the address must carry two or more names our own objects reference, __unwind$/__catch$/$L/??_C@ names are excluded as annotations rather than aliases, and the survivor must be the single member the target objects define.
_provenance.retail_map_splitter_named: Added 2026-08-10. Companion to retail_map_classes: addresses where the linker map names none of the symbols the TARGET objects define, because the splitter invented that name (merged_*, OnlyReturns). The survivor is then read from target_symbol_map.json and the folded members from the map. Address-derived survivors (fn_/lbl_) stay refused by gate (d) -- those are a rename problem, not an alias one.

retail_map_data_comdat_classes.what: /OPT:ICF folds byte-identical COMDATs. The installed retail_map_classes tier evaluates its member and survivor gates with function COMDATs only, so every DATA COMDAT the linker folded was invisible to it -- not refused on evidence, not seen. These groups re-run those four gates over the whole COFF external-definition table and add a fifth: for every member our objects DEFINE, the COMDAT contents must equal the target survivor's with relocation-patched fields masked and relocation targets equal by name, which is the condition ICF actually tests. A group with a mismatching member, or with no member our objects define, is refused fail-closed.
retail_map_data_comdat_classes.padding_normalisation: identity_mode 'align' additionally admits a target COMDAT that is our bytes followed by fewer than 8 zero bytes landing the end on an 8-byte boundary. Of the 254 ??_8 COMDATs defined on both sides, 176 are byte-identical, 78 are exactly ours + 4 trailing zeros and 0 differ in content; those 4 bytes are inter-symbol alignment padding dtk's splitter attributed to the vbtable, not a retail emission difference. Discriminator (retail_map_fold_candidates.py --padding-evidence, no exceptions in 254): 47 flush with a 4-byte-aligned successor, 129 flush already on the boundary, 78 padded with an 8-byte-aligned successor and an off-boundary end. The 47 are the control an emitted terminator entry fails. 'strict' refuses the padding and admits 176 of the 254 instead.
retail_map_data_comdat_classes.decomp_synth_validator: validate_groups rejects 102 of these on gate (a) alone -- survivor absent from scripts/target_symbol_map.json, which holds 0 data symbols in 69,132 names and has the same function-only blindness. Gates 4 and 5 make that check directly against the objects. load_validated therefore drops them and decomp-synth grades stricter than this file; objdiff reads the rendered map and honours them.
